name: Titan-Scar Threshold
introDiscord:
The oldest graves lie beyond a natural gate formed by two enormous
Leviathan skeletons.

Ancient Guardians still patrol the threshold.
introTwitch:
The oldest graves lie beyond a natural gate formed by two enormous
Leviathan skeletons.

Ancient Guardians still patrol the threshold.

titan-scar-threshold-approach.prompt: Three routes cross beneath the titanic bone gate.

left.message:
A Titan-Scar Guardian awakens beneath carvings worn almost smooth by
time.

right.message:
One Berry sits beside Shizuki's note:

'This feels like entrance to something older.

Glimmer stopped wandering ahead.

That is how I know it's serious.'

forward.message: A strongbox rests beneath the ancient gate.

titan-scar-threshold-depths.prompt: The threshold narrows between enormous scars.

left.message:
A mineral pool rests beneath an old marker.

Shizuki wrote:

'Rest here.

No joke.

Whatever is beyond this gate deserves attention.'

right.message: A Guardian steps from the scarred stone.

forward.message: Star Candies rest inside a hollow scale.

titan-scar-threshold-threshold.prompt: Leviathan Seal closes around three final approaches.

left.message:
A navigator's chest rests beneath weathered carvings of enormous
swimming forms.

right.message:
Shizuki's final bottle sits beside a small Glimmer doodle.

'Ready when you are.'

forward.message: A Titan-Scar Guardian blocks the Seal.

boss-antechamber.name: Leviathan Seal
boss-antechamber.prompt: The ancient carvings around Leviathan Seal begin glowing.

bossPromptDiscord:
The ancient carvings around Leviathan Seal begin glowing.

A towering guardian rises beneath images of creatures far larger than
anything still alive in the Wake.

Use /yes to cross the Leviathan Seal or /no to leave the oldest graves
unopened.
bossPromptTwitch:
The ancient carvings around Leviathan Seal begin glowing.

A towering guardian rises beneath images of creatures far larger than
anything still alive in the Wake.

Use !yes to cross the Leviathan Seal or !no to leave the oldest graves
unopened.
bossRetreatText: You step away from the ancient threshold.

boss.revealText:
The scarred guardian raises its weapon.

Scarbound Warden reveals itself!

completionText:
The Warden falls silent.

The Seal opens.

Beyond it lies one scale.

Larger than any you have seen.

And unlike the others...

it still glows.
